entries.name: Butter Bridge
entries.description: Butter's Base bridge endpoint. Outbound transfers lock or burn assets and emit messages for the MAP relay chain; inbound transfers execute only after a LightNode-validated receipt proof for the configured MAP relay contract. The bridge can mint configured mintable tokens, release escrowed assets, and invoke receiver callbacks, so compromise of validation, relay configuration, or management authority can lead to loss of bridged funds.

$implementation.description: Current implementation of the upgradeable Butter Bridge proxy.

authority.description: Authority contract consulted by all Bridge management functions marked restricted. Its role members can pause the bridge, change supported tokens and service contracts, change the relay, configure trust-list entries, and upgrade the Bridge implementation.

getRelay.description: MAP relay contract whose MessageRelay events are accepted by this Bridge. A malicious or incorrectly configured relay address could make otherwise valid proofs execute the wrong messages.

lightNode.description: LightNode used to validate MAP relay-chain headers and receipt proofs before Bridge messages are executed.

feeService.description: FeeService used to calculate and route message fees. Its authority can change gas prices, base gas values, token decimals, and the fee receiver.

paused.description: Whether bridge transfers and message execution are paused. The authority can toggle this circuit breaker.

getTransferOutFailedReceiver.description: Fallback recipient for assets when a destination-side receiver or swap callback fails. The configured authority can change where such recovered assets are sent.

entries.name: Butter MAP LightNode
entries.description: Upgradeable MAP relay-chain light client used by Butter bridges. It verifies relay-chain headers with the stored BLS validator set and verifies receipt Merkle proofs against accepted headers. It is the destination-chain validation boundary for bridged messages.

verifyTool.description: VerifyTool contract used for header-signature and receipt Merkle-proof primitives. Replacing it changes the cryptographic validation logic used by the LightNode.

headerHeight.description: Highest MAP relay-chain header accepted by this LightNode. Receipt proofs outside the rolling verifiable range cannot be used by the Bridge.

epochSize.description: Number of MAP relay-chain blocks in one LightNode epoch. It determines the required spacing between accepted validator-set checkpoints and the block-height boundaries used for header validation.

epochSummary.description: Latest epoch stats (vali set size). Complicated handler because of the ring buffer.

verifiableHeaderRange.description: Current range of MAP relay-chain block heights accepted by the LightNode. The range is derived from the last accepted header and the configured epoch retention window.

getValidators.description: Stored BLS validator public keys used to authenticate MAP relay-chain headers. The active set and its 2/3-style threshold determine which relay-chain history the Bridge accepts.

receivedPermissions.description: change the pending LightNode administrator or the VerifyTool used by proof verification.

entries.name: Butter AuthorityManager
entries.description: OpenZeppelin AccessManager-derived authority for Butter's restricted Bridge and FeeService functions. Its role configuration controls who can change bridge validation dependencies, relay and token settings, fee parameters, pause state, and implementation upgrades.

adminRole.description: Current ADMIN_ROLE members of the AuthorityManager. They control the role and target-function configuration used to authorize Butter Bridge and FeeService management calls.

entries.name: Butter VerifyTool
entries.description: Cryptographic and RLP/Merkle-proof helper contract called by the Butter MAP LightNode to validate relay-chain headers and transaction receipts.

entries.name: Butter FeeService
entries.description: Fee configuration contract used by Butter Bridge to calculate cross-chain message fees and select the fee recipient.

authority.description: Authority contract consulted by FeeService management functions. Its role members can change fee parameters and the fee receiver.

feeReceiver.description: Current recipient returned by FeeService for message fees collected by the Bridge.

baseGasBase.description: Base gas component used by FeeService when pricing messages to Base. Authority members can change this value.

baseFeeInfo.description: FeeService's current Base/WETH pricing tuple: base gas, gas price, and fee receiver. Authority members can change the pricing inputs and receiver.
